record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a bounded relative-frequency input cue using item counts from training interactions only. For visible real items, compute log1p(count), center it over visible history items, divide by its history standard deviation plus 1e-6, and scale existing input item vectors by 1 + 0.05*tanh(z). Keep padding zero and mask-token scale 1; never use masked identities in feature computation. Relative frequency may distinguish niche context from common purchases without adding a scorer. Keep learned embeddings, topology, positions, readout, loss and optimizer fixed. Save count buffers in each category’s single checkpoint and reproduce the feature in the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Add a mild relative-frequency cue from training interactions across all four categories. Standardize log counts using only visible real items in each input history and scale their existing vectors by 1 + 0.05*tanh(z). Padding stays zero and mask-token scaling stays one. Counts persist in each model checkpoint; the generated predictor imports the updated model class and restores its buffer automatically. Learned embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain fixed.
